name: The Hunter's Path
label: Quest
description: The Hunter's Path: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
You must see Thotar at Razor Hill. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I believe you are ready to be trained...
